data.body: review-plan PASS (signed at 717c50f8b33). Acting on 2 advisories within scope: (a) when MCP composes its box op-cert signer (REBAR_OPCERT_ENV_ID set), startup also validates the authorship key named by identity.signing_key with the same keyprov checks (exists, regular, 0600, valid Ed25519) and fails closed, preserving today's posture where an empty/invalid key stopped startup; no new config. (b) Setting REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH in the MCP container also points the unbound op-cert fallback in _opcert_signing at the same op-cert key instead of the tracker genesis key; intended, same key as the bound signer. Not acted on: blast-radius advisory about the MCP container holding the bot key; that is the operator's recorded decision.
